notes: The check at clock edges is implemented as required. The "one time step after the falling edge of i_rst_n" part is not checked. It needs a delayed event (#1 after negedge i_rst_n), and the rules forbid delays in initial blocks and don't allow a --timing-dependent construct. A same-time-step check would race with the DUT's asynchronous reset update. Asynchronous reset behaviour is therefore covered only at clock edges where i_rst_n=0. The assertion has no disable iff, as required for during-reset checks. The hit counter counts every edge with reset asserted.
